# Forensic test coverage

Which forensic checks exist for each part of Crush: the sources it opens, the filesystems it reads in a disk image, the file formats it parses and its decoding tools. This page lists what is checked, not whether the checks pass — every release runs them on Linux, macOS and Windows and attaches the results as the [forensic audit report](https://kalink0.github.io/crush-forensics/audit/).

A check runs on committed reference files or on files the test creates. It shows that Crush behaves as described for those files, not for every possible input.

In the tables, a number is how many checks exist; **not tested** means there is no check in that category; **n/a** means the category doesn't apply (the reason is given under the part).

## Categories

- **Source Immutability** — The tool must never modify digital evidence it reads. These tests verify that after any VFS read operation the source data is byte-identical to its pre-examination state.
- **No Side Effects** — Parsing an artifact must not create additional files next to the evidence. Sibling files such as SQLite WAL or journal entries would alter the evidence directory and compromise the examination.
- **Read-only Media** — The tool must operate correctly when evidence has read-only permissions (chmod 0o444 / 0o555), simulating examination of write-protected forensic media.
- **Known-output Verification** — Committed reference artifacts must parse to their exact, pre-computed values. These are fixed-point checks: if parser output changes for a known input, the test fails.
- **Completeness** — Every plausible interpretation of a value must always be produced — silently omitting a valid interpretation means potentially missing forensic evidence. These tests verify that no interpretation group is ever dropped.
- **Reproducibility** — Parsing the same artifact twice must produce identical results. Non-deterministic output would undermine the reliability of forensic findings.

## Checks

### Sources

#### Folder

- **Source Immutability** — DirectoryVFS read/peek must leave source file bytes unchanged ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_directory_vfs_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Source Immutability** — DirectoryVFS read/peek must not change mtime or ctime of source files ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_directory_vfs_does_not_change_timestamps`)
- **Source Immutability** — DirectoryVFS read/peek must not update atime (Linux: O_NOATIME, Windows: utime restore) ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_directory_vfs_does_not_change_atime`)
- *Not tested:* No Side Effects, Read-only Media, Known-output Verification, Completeness, Reproducibility

#### Single file

No forensic checks.

#### ZIP archive

- **Source Immutability** — Exhaustively reading every entry of a ZIP archive must leave it byte-identical ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_vfs_does_not_modify_archive`)
- **Source Immutability** — ZipVFS must not change mtime or ctime of the archive file ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_vfs_does_not_change_timestamps`)
- **Source Immutability** — Decrypting a legacy-ZipCrypto-encrypted ZIP must leave the source file byte-identical ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_legacy_encrypted_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Source Immutability** — Decrypting a WinZip-AES-encrypted ZIP must leave the source file byte-identical ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_aes_encrypted_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Read-only Media** — ZipVFS must read all entries when the archive file is chmod 0o444 ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_vfs_works_on_readonly_media`)
- **Known-output Verification** — minimal.zip must contain exactly: evidence/minimal.sqlite and evidence/minimal_binary.plist ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_fixture_contains_expected_entries`)
- **Known-output Verification** — The pyaff4 container (every member stored with month 0) opens as a ZIP ([test_stored_times.py](../../crush/tests/test_stored_times.py), `test_real_pyaff4_container_opens_as_zip`)
- **Completeness** — A ZIP member with an invalid DOS date must not stop the archive from opening; the member shows its stored date as not valid, the others keep theirs ([test_stored_times.py](../../crush/tests/test_stored_times.py), `test_invalid_date_keeps_archive_open`)
- **Reproducibility** — Reading the same ZIP archive entry twice must return byte-identical data ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_zip_vfs_read_is_reproducible`)
- **Reproducibility** — A ZIP DOS time is shown the same on every analysis machine, whatever its time zone ([test_stored_times.py](../../crush/tests/test_stored_times.py), `test_independent_of_analysis_time_zone`)
- *Not tested:* No Side Effects

#### gzip file

#### Raw disk image

- **Source Immutability** — RawImageVFS read/peek must leave the image file's bytes unchanged ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_raw_image_vfs_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Source Immutability** — RawImageVFS read/peek must not change mtime or ctime of the image file ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_raw_image_vfs_does_not_change_timestamps`)

- **Known-output Verification** — Every file on the logical volumes of an LVM2 volume group (one run, split into runs, striped, RAID1) reads back with the bytes hashed from the mounted volumes ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_every_file_lvm_wrote_reads_back_under_its_logical_volume`)
- **Known-output Verification** — The space no partition covers is listed up to the image's end and reads as the image holds it; an LVM2 volume read through a map adds no gap of its own ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_a_volume_read_through_a_map_leaves_no_gap_past_the_image`)
- **Known-output Verification** — An LVM2 RAID1 volume says which copy it is read from and that the copies are not compared; a split or striped volume lists every run with its offset in the image ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_what_the_reader_reports_on_each_volume_is_shown`)
- **Known-output Verification** — The extents of an LVM2 physical volume no logical volume holds are listed and read as the image holds them ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_lvm_free_extents_are_a_readable_region_of_their_own`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A LUKS container without its passphrase is listed as locked, with the reader's reason, and reads as the bytes on the disk ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_a_luks_container_stays_listed_until_its_passphrase_is_given`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A LUKS1 container opened with its passphrase lists files with the bytes its volume held, and the container still reads as the encrypted bytes on the disk ([test_raw_image_lvm.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_lvm.py), `test_a_luks_container_opens_with_its_passphrase`)
- **Known-output Verification** — Every file on the LVM2 RAID4, RAID5, RAID6 and RAID10 logical volumes of one image reads back with the bytes hashed through the device lvm2 assembled ([test_raw_image_raid.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_raid.py), `test_every_file_on_lvm_raid_volumes_in_one_image_reads_back`)
- **Completeness** — A file or recovered deleted file whose reader returns fewer or more bytes than its recorded size must fail to read, never pass as the whole file ([test_raw_image_vfs.py](../../crush/tests/test_raw_image_vfs.py), `test_live_and_deleted_reads_refuse_another_length`)
- **Reproducibility** — Reading the same file from a raw image twice must return byte-identical data ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_raw_image_vfs_read_is_reproducible`)

### File formats

#### SQLite database

- **Source Immutability** — SQLiteParser must not change mtime or ctime of source files ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_parser_does_not_change_timestamps`)
- **No Side Effects** — SQLiteParser must preserve the WAL companion intact — parsing must not checkpoint or truncate it ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_parser_preserves_wal_companion`)
- **No Side Effects** — SQLiteParser must not create -wal, -journal, or any sibling file next to the evidence ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_parse_creates_no_sibling_files`)
- **Read-only Media** — SQLiteParser must succeed when the evidence directory is 0o555 and file is 0o444 ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_parser_works_on_readonly_media`)
- **Known-output Verification** — minimal.sqlite must parse to exactly: table 'evidence', columns [id, note], row (1, 'test_entry') ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_fixture_known_output`)
- **Reproducibility** — Parsing the same SQLite file twice must produce structurally identical results ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_sqlite_parse_is_reproducible`)
- *Not tested:* Completeness

#### SQLite WAL

No forensic checks.

- *Not tested:* Source Immutability, Read-only Media, Known-output Verification, Completeness, Reproducibility

- **Source Immutability** — RealmParser read must leave source file bytes unchanged ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_parser_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Source Immutability** — RealmParser must not change mtime or ctime of source files ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_parser_does_not_change_timestamps`)
- **No Side Effects** — RealmParser must not create any sibling files next to the evidence ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_parse_creates_no_sibling_files`)
- **Read-only Media** — RealmParser must succeed when evidence directory is 0o555 and file is 0o444 ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_parser_works_on_readonly_media`)
- **Known-output Verification** — minimal.realm must parse to exactly: schema ['metadata', 'class_Evidence'], Tables found=2 ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — minimal_format9.realm (file format 9) must parse to exactly: schema ['metadata', 'class_LegacyRecord'], missing table structure explicitly flagged ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_format9_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — streaming_form.realm (genuine realm-js writeCopyTo() output, real streaming-form file, not a hand-rebuilt header) must resolve the real top ref from the footer and decode its one user table correctly ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_streaming_form_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — ifttt_v9_data.realm (real file format 9 sample, DFRWS/Magnet CTF dataset) must fully decode: 21 classes, no unsupported columns, correct row values ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_ifttt_v9_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — mcdonalds_v9_data.realm (real file format 9 sample, DFRWS 2021 Challenge dataset) must fully decode: 5 classes, no unsupported columns, correct row values ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_mcdonalds_v9_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — all_types_v24.realm (real file format 24, actual realm-js SDK output) must decode every modern column type correctly, including Decimal128, Link, LinkList, and nested Mixed collections ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_all_types_v24_fixture_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — format9_alltypes.realm (real file format 9, realm-core v5.23.9's own public API output, donated by the issue #55 reporter) must decode every old ColumnType correctly against the accompanying expected.json, including Mixed and a populated Table/subtable -- the two pieces this parser's own test suite could previously only cover synthetically ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_format9_alltypes_fixture_known_output`)
- **Completeness** — Strings in arrays only the inactive snapshot reaches, lying in freed blocks, are listed and attributed to the previous snapshot ([test_realm_strings.py](../../crush/tests/test_realm_strings.py), `test_previous_snapshot_strings_are_attributed`)
- **Reproducibility** — Parsing the same Realm file twice must produce structurally identical results ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_realm_parse_is_reproducible`)

#### LevelDB

- **Source Immutability** — LevelDB directory files must be byte-identical after parsing ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_leveldb_does_not_modify_source`)
- **Source Immutability** — LevelDB parser must not change mtime or ctime of source directory files ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_leveldb_does_not_change_timestamps`)
- **No Side Effects** — LevelDB parsing must not create files next to the evidence directory ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_leveldb_no_sibling_files`)
- **Read-only Media** — LevelDB parser must succeed when directory and files are read-only (0o555/0o444) ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_leveldb_read_only_media`)
- **Known-output Verification** — File numbers must be read as LevelDB writes them (decimal), so a file's level, size and key range are its own ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_file_numbers_are_decimal`)
- **Known-output Verification** — The current MANIFEST must be the one CURRENT names, not the highest-numbered; a higher-numbered one is shown and marked ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_current_names_the_manifest`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A .log record whose stored checksum doesn't match must be shown and marked, not passed off as a normal record ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_log_record_with_wrong_checksum_is_marked`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A RocksDB directory (LevelDB's file names, other formats) must be recognised by content and not read as LevelDB ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_rocksdb_options_file_is_recognised`)
- **Completeness** — A data file that can't be opened must be listed with its reason and must not hide the other files' records ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_table_file_without_magic_keeps_the_other_files`)
- **Completeness** — A data file that fails partway must keep the records read before it, say where it stopped, and not stop the files after it ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_file_failing_midway_keeps_its_records_and_the_others`)
- **Completeness** — A damaged part of a .log must be skipped and named, and the records after it read, as LevelDB reads on ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_leveldb_damaged_log_part_is_skipped_and_reading_goes_on`)
- **Completeness** — A damaged MANIFEST record must not make a LevelDB look like RocksDB and leave all its records unread ([test_structured_issues.py](../../crush/tests/test_structured_issues.py), `test_damaged_manifest_record_is_not_taken_for_rocksdb`)
- **Reproducibility** — Parsing the same LevelDB directory twice must produce identical results ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_leveldb_parse_is_reproducible`)

#### Chromium Disk Cache

- **Source Immutability** — Cache files must be byte-identical after parsing and reading every entry's details ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_does_not_modify_source`)

- **Known-output Verification** — A Simple HTTP cache entry must give its key parts, times, headers, server, protocol and certificate ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_simple_http_entry_facts`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A CacheStorage cache named by index.txt must decode stream 0 as CacheMetadata and the index field as prefetch size ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_cache_storage_with_index_txt`)

- **Known-output Verification** — index-dir opened on its own must not report its records as entries without entry files ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_index_dir_opened_alone_does_not_claim_missing_entry_files`)
- **Known-output Verification** — A Blockfile cache must give every entry the index reaches, with state, times and its external body ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_blockfile_entries`)
- **Known-output Verification** — Sparse children Chromium wouldn't read for the parent must not be mixed into its body; listed apart with why ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_sparse_children_checked_like_chromium`)
- **Completeness** — A cache folder must be recognised by its files' bytes even when every file is renamed ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_folder_detected_by_content_not_names`)
- **Completeness** — The body must stay RAW as stored; the declared Content-Encoding gives a separate derived body ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_body_raw_untouched_and_derived_separate`)
- **Completeness** — Index records whose entry file is gone must be listed with hash, last-used time and size ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_index_record_without_file_is_listed`)
- **Completeness** — Without index.txt, CacheStorage entries must show every valid reading of stream 0 and both readings of the index field, marked as heuristic ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_cache_storage_without_index_txt_shows_readings`)
- **Completeness** — A body whose coded data ends early must give the part that decodes, marked partial, never nothing ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_cut_off_body_gives_the_decodable_start_marked_partial`)
- **Completeness** — An entry record in a free block whose key hash matches its key must be listed as a heuristic recovery with its reason ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_blockfile_free_block_is_carved_as_heuristic`)
- **Reproducibility** — Parsing the same cache twice must produce identical results ([test_chromium_cache.py](../../crush/tests/test_chromium_cache.py), `test_parse_is_reproducible`)

- *Not tested:* Source Immutability, No Side Effects, Read-only Media, Completeness, Reproducibility

### Tools

#### BLOB Inspector

- **Source Immutability** — Reading blob_samples.db must leave the fixture file byte-identical ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_samples_db_not_modified`)
- **Known-output Verification** — blob_samples.db 'b64url_json': Base64url decode must yield JSON starting with {"sub" ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_b64url_json_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — blob_samples.db 'b64url_plist': Base64url decode must yield an XML plist ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_b64url_plist_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — blob_samples.db 'lzfse_json': lzfse decompress must yield JSON with 'bundleId' ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_lzfse_json_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — blob_samples.db 'b64url_lzfse_json': two-step Base64url→lzfse pipeline must yield JSON ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_b64url_lzfse_pipeline_known_output`)
- **Completeness** — Bytes after the end of a zlib, gzip or lzfse stream must be reported with offset and size, not dropped ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_decode_reports_bytes_after_stream_end`)
- **Completeness** — Base64 and hex steps must reject characters outside their alphabet instead of skipping them ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_decode_rejects_foreign_characters`)
- **Reproducibility** — Blob Inspector decode functions must produce byte-identical output on repeated calls ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_blob_decode_functions_are_reproducible`)
- *Not tested:* No Side Effects, Read-only Media

#### Value Inspector

- **Known-output Verification** — Unix timestamp 1718000000 must always decode to 2024-06-10 06:13:20 UTC ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_unix_timestamp_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — Cocoa timestamp 760000000 must always decode to a date in 2025 ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_cocoa_timestamp_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — Hex bytes 'c0 a8 01 01' must always decode to IPv4 192.168.1.1 (big-endian) ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_ipv4_known_output`)
- **Known-output Verification** — Hex bytes 'f7 f8 f9 fa fb fc' must always decode to MAC f7:f8:f9:fa:fb:fc ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_mac_known_output`)
- **Completeness** — Value Inspector must never silently drop any interpretation group for a multi-type value ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_no_silent_group_omission`)
- **Completeness** — Value Inspector must always show both big-endian and little-endian integer for hex-byte input ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_both_endians_present`)
- **Reproducibility** — Value Inspector must produce identical ordered output on repeated calls for the same input ([test_forensic.py](../../crush/tests/test_forensic.py), `test_value_inspector_is_reproducible`)
